verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents in-platform task assignment with deadlines, and AI checks of uploaded (manual) evidence for timeliness that flag outdated timestamps before audit. That gives glancing support for ownership, due dates and staleness on manual artifacts. The owner and due-date tracking that is documented in detail belongs to AI-system findings, not general manual evidence. Missing for 10: per-artifact owner assignment for manual evidence, recurring renewal reminders, expiry-date tracking on every manual artifact, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact

citations.quote: Assign tasks, set deadlines, and work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform.
Use Sprinto AI to automatically validate your uploaded evidence for relevance, scope, and timeliness before audit submission.
Sprinto AI analyses your submission and flags gaps such as outdated timestamps or irrelevant screenshots
